about_the_game:
OUT NOW!! 🧟

Fight against massive hordes of relentless flesh-hungry zombies in this top-down, 2D action packed shoot 'em up! Experience bite-sized, highly replayable arcade action as you exterminate the undead in bloody combat across unique and challenging arena-style levels.

  • Face hundreds of zombies on screen at once, with 5 different distinct enemy types to encounter and kill, this time permanently...

  • Aggressively blast and shoot hordes of zombies with your choice of 3 different zombie-slaughtering vehicles, each with their own unique playstyles. Shoot in multiple different directions at once with unique controls as you unleash a barrage of explosive tank shells and thousands of bullets at the undead masses running at you...

  • Witness the zombies and environments around you react as you blow them to pieces, sending walls, cars, zombies, and more flying around in intense and destructive moment-to-moment gameplay...

  • Step into a world overrun with the undead in a narrative told across 7 unique levels, with each level consisting of a unique arena to fight the undead in and designed to be replayable, surviving and holding out until the timer finally expires...

  • Feel the crumbling world around you brought to life with moody, atmospheric environments, featuring hand-drawn art, custom-created sounds and music, and terrifying, bloody undead hordes tireless in their hunger for flesh...

  • Discover a lore page, stats to track your total zombies killed, and a bonus unlockable level featuring tower defense gameplay...

content_descriptors.notes: Blood splatters from enemies taking damage and being killed with various weapons.

  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7500U @ 2.7 GHz
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 620
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 270 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or equivalent
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: The Undead Containment Zone is on the verge of collapse and about to unleash massive hordes of flesh-hungry zombies. Become the first line of defense by commanding powerful vehicles known as Armored Land Carriers, equipped with firepower and maneuverability capable of neutralizing the undead masses.
